description: Hotelzify lets users search hotels, check live room availability and pricing for specific dates, and submit a hotel reservation request only after explicit confirmation of the room, dates, rate plan, guest details, and price. Search results and room options are shown as interactive widgets so users can browse properties, compare rate plans, and make an informed reservation request in one conversation. No payment is collected in the ChatGPT app.
